chunks: Sahl narrated from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Ibn Abi Najran or someone else, from Hanaan, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Ka'bah complained to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, about what it endures from the breaths of the polytheists. So Allah revealed to it: 'Be calm, O Ka'bah, for I will replace them with a people who clean themselves with the twigs of the tree.' So when Allah sent Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), He revealed to him with Jibra'il (peace be upon him) the Siwak and the Khilal.

key_terms.قُضْبَانِ الشَّجَرِ: Twigs of the tree (referring to the source of Siwak)

ai.seo_question: What is the origin of using Siwak in Islam according to the Ka'bah's complaint?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the divine origin of oral hygiene, linking the physical cleanliness of the Ka'bah to the spiritual purity of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). It underscores the Shia emphasis on *taharah* (purity) as a prerequisite for worship, framing the Siwak not merely as a cultural habit but as a revealed practice (*wahy*) associated with Jibril. This narrative reinforces the theological connection between bodily cleanliness and the sanctity of the House of Allah.

en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ibn Abu Najran, or someone else, from Hanaan, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Kabah complained to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic what is faced from the (smelly) breating from the Polytheists. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed unto it: “Calm down, Kabah, for I<sup>azwj</sup> would be Replacing them with a people who would be cleaning (their teeth) with the twigs of the tree”. 
So when Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sent Muhammad<sup>azwj</sup>, Revealed unto him<sup>saww</sup> with Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> with the brushing of the teeth, and picking the teeth (with a tooth-pick)’.
en.sarwar: 32. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from ibn abu Najran or others from Hanan from his father who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

Al-Ka‘bah complained before Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, against the bad breath of the pagans. Allah sent a revelation that said, ‘Calm down. I will replace them with a people who will use twigs for cleaning up their mouths. 5 Allah then raised Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and Jibril brought him revelation that instructed him to brush and clean up his mouth.’”
